strategy.name: MTF Trend Pullback + ATR Risk System

indicators.EMA200: major trend and market regime filter

long_allowed_only_if_all_true: Daily EMA50 slope is up over the latest 10 daily bars
Symbol 20-day performance is stronger than the selected benchmark index
Market benchmark has not clearly broken below daily EMA200

watch_pullback_if_all_true_after_long_bi: Price is near EMA20 or between EMA20 and EMA50
RSI14 is in the 40-55 reset zone
Pullback is not a high-volume selloff
Close has not effectively broken EMA50

BUY_TRIGGER_CONSERVATIVE: Trigger timeframe close is back above EMA20
Current trigger candle closes above prior trigger candle high
BUY_TRIGGER_AGGRESSIVE: Price holds the EMA20-EMA50 pullback zone without breaking the prior pullback low
15m or 1H closes above short-term descending structure

SELL_INVALIDATED_if_any_true: Close breaks the current pullback low
RSI14 breaks below 40 while price cannot reclaim EMA20
Market benchmark closes below EMA200 for two consecutive daily bars

risk_rules: Single-trade risk is capped at 0.5%-1.0% of account equity
Initial stop = min(current pullback low - 0.5 ATR, entry price - 2 ATR)
If entry-to-stop distance is too wide, reduce position size automatically in planning
Maximum three same-direction positions in the same sector
Stop opening new positions after a 2% daily loss
Stop opening new positions after a 4% weekly loss
Pause and review the strategy after an 8%-12% account drawdown
take_profit: At +1R, move stop close to breakeven
At +2R, take profit on one third
At +3R, take profit on another third
Trail remaining position with EMA20 or 3 ATR
Exit all if close breaks EMA50
notes: Research, screening, alerting, watchlist management, and review only. Do not place trades. Do not present strategy output as a profit guarantee.
